integrity: Finite complete signed integral Morse calculation with a reproducible standard-library checker; the checker directly enumerates all faces and Hasse incidences and independently checks field ranks. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite nonequivariant classification for the Shrikhande and 4-by-4 rook graphs only. It does not generalize to other strongly regular parameter sets, determine the symmetry action, or certify literature novelty. A known bipartite-cover isomorphism already entails the equality of the two open-neighborhood complexes.
title: Projective-plane summands in the open-neighborhood complexes of the Shrikhande and rook graphs
